newsitem.title: DUBAI: Rates on one, three, six month Saudi t-bills rise.
newsitem.headline: Rates on one, three, six month Saudi t-bills rise.

text.p: Yields on one, three and six month treasury bills climbed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering worth three billion riyals, a banker said.
The yield on 28-day bills rose to 5.3585 percent from 5.3331 and the rate on 91-day paper climbed to 5.4598 from 5.4439. The rate on 182-day bills increased to 5.5381 percent from 5.5035.
One-, three- and six-month riyal interbank deposit rates were at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, 5-9/16, 7/16 and 5-5/8, 1/2 percent respectively.
